findings.evidence: mathlib-shims.json:4-29 maps only `Complex.exists_bijOn_unitBall_map_eq_zero` to files including Rouche and Vitali, whose docstrings require corresponding Rouché/Vitali lemmas; lines 34-44 and 141-150 similarly group distinct APIs. Lines 225-232 fan out any matched target to every source.
findings.fix: Map probes to individual sources and require each source's actual replacement targets; represent PR/module landing sentinels separately and do not emit source-deletion advice from them.
findings.issue: Any target found for a group marks every grouped source replaceable. This falsely labels unrelated or only partially upstreamed APIs as obsolete, including all 21 Riemann-mapping files, both automorphism files, and both ValuativeRel files.

findings.evidence: TauCeti/RingTheory/DedekindDomain/SInteger/Unit.lean:65-78 names the four non-upstream declarations and states the latter two must be re-homed; registry lines 47-56 nevertheless associate the entire source with the upstream probe.
findings.fix: Track only declarations genuinely replaced by upstream and preserve/re-home `mem_unit_iff`, `unit_mono`, `unit_fg_of_units`, and `algebraMap_unitEmptyEquivUnits_apply`; avoid whole-file deletion messaging.
findings.issue: The S-unit entry reports the whole file obsolete when `Set.unit_fg` or the module appears, although the file explicitly contains four declarations absent from upstream and says two must be re-homed rather than deleted.

summary: The probe conflates upstream activity with source-level replacement, producing materially false migration and deletion alerts.
